loLife.claim: Lo Life is an enduring Polo collector and styling culture, with vivid primary colors and bold color blocking visible in selected early-1990s Polo collections
loLife.observed: Original Lo Life member Rack-Lo describes red, yellow and blue styling and Lo Down culture in a first-person interview; Ralph Lauren describes the Snow Beach palette, bold graphics and New York street uptake; its September 2026 PoloFest announcement documents continuing collector and fan activity. These sources support continued interest in the style, not a claim that all Polo garments have the same colors.
loLife.articleDecision: brief culture paragraph without a Lo Life shop link; a future fashion affiliate article needs separate product, rights, attribution, click tracking and conversion verification
